title: LatBridge: Efficient and Stable Model Replacement in Latent-Communication Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: LatBridge：潜在通信多智能体系统中高效稳定的模型替换方法

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent systems rely on communication to complete tasks, and latent communication passes continuous representations to reduce text generation and re-encoding. However, multi-agent systems must reconfigure agent models, whereas existing latent-communication methods are built for fixed model combinations, so their interfaces may fail after replacement. Our pilot study confirms this interface failure and identifies the requirement for interface reuse after model replacement. We present LatBridge , which connects agent models through a shared Bridge and separate interfaces under a shared latent-communication protocol. After agent model replacement, LatBridge reuses unchanged interfaces, selects matching low-rank interfaces, and combines them through the Bridge, training only missing ones with all models frozen. The Bridge processes source representations in the basic mode and constructs target input without autoregressive generation in the accelerated mode. Experiments support effective communication after model replacement, with mean basic-mode accuracies of 14.8% on MATH and 27.3% on ALFWorld next-action prediction across eight small-model configurations. Analyses examine the factors supporting task accuracy and communication efficiency.

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent systems organize language models as agents with different roles and use communication to exchange information, divide tasks, and make collaborative decisions ( Li et al., 2023 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) . Most existing systems communicate through text, but generating and re-encoding intermediate text increases communication time and converts continuous internal representations into discrete text. To reduce these limitations, previous studies have explored latent communication, which exchanges continuous representations such as embeddings ( Pham et al., 2024 ) , activations ( Ramesh and Li, 2025 ) , hidden states ( Du et al., 2026 ) , and key-value caches ( Shi et al., 2026 ) . At the same time, multi-agent systems need to select models according to task and resource requirements ( Yue et al., 2025 ) and adjust communication topology for different forms of collaboration ( Li et al., 2024 ; Shen et al., 2025a ) . These changes may require replacing the model assigned to an agent. However, existing latent-communication methods mainly build communication interfaces for fixed sending and receiving models ( Du et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2025 ) . It remains unclear whether communication interfaces trained by these methods can continue to pass useful information after the model assigned to an agent is replaced.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体系统将语言模型组织为具有不同角色的智能体，并利用通信来交换信息、划分任务以及进行协作决策 ( Li et al., 2023 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) 。 现有的大多数系统通过文本进行通信，但生成和重新编码中间文本会增加通信时间，并将连续的内部表示转换为离散文本。 为了减少这些局限，已有研究探索了潜在通信，即交换嵌入 ( Pham et al., 2024 ) 、激活 ( Ramesh and Li, 2025 ) 、隐藏状态 ( Du et al., 2026 ) 以及键值缓存 ( Shi et al., 2026 ) 等连续表示。 与此同时，多智能体系统需要根据任务和资源需求选择模型 ( Yue et al., 2025 ) ，并针对不同形式的协作调整通信拓扑 ( Li et al., 2024 ; Shen et al., 2025a ) 。 这些变化可能需要替换分配给某个智能体的模型。 然而，现有的潜在通信方法主要针对固定的发送模型和接收模型构建通信接口 ( Du et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2025 ) 。 在分配给某个智能体的模型被替换后，通过这些方法训练的通信接口能否继续传递有用信息，目前仍不清楚。

paragraphs.en: To test whether the original communication interface remains usable after model replacement, we conduct a pilot study based on Interlat ( Du et al., 2026 ) . The results show that replacing the model assigned to an agent without retraining the interface substantially reduces the original communication gain, indicating that an interface trained for the original model combination cannot be directly applied to a new endpoint model. This result motivates a shared communication protocol for all agents, implemented through a shared communication component that divides the model-pair-dependent representation mapping across its two sides. With this protocol, replacing a model changes only its connection to this component, allowing the interface on the unchanged side to be reused and a new adjacent interface to be trained only when no matching interface exists. However, if this component uses a complete language model to generate and process communicated content token by token, this additional step increases communication latency and makes communication time depend on the generated sequence length. We therefore need a latent-communication method that reduces both the interface retraining required after model replacement and the processing latency introduced by the shared communication component.
paragraphs.zh: 为测试替换模型后原有通信接口是否仍然可用，我们基于 Interlat（Du et al., 2026）开展了一项初步研究。 结果表明，在不重新训练接口的情况下替换分配给某个智能体的模型，会大幅削弱原有的通信增益，这说明为原模型组合训练的接口无法直接应用于新的端点模型。 这一结果促使我们为所有智能体设计一种共享通信协议，通过一个共享通信组件来实现，该组件将依赖于模型对的表示映射划分到其两侧。 采用这一协议后，替换模型只需改变该模型与该组件的连接，使得不变一侧的接口可以复用，只有在不存在匹配接口时才需要训练新的相邻接口。 然而，如果该组件使用完整的语言模型逐个词元地生成和处理通信内容，这一额外步骤会增加通信延迟，并使通信时间依赖于生成序列的长度。 因此，我们需要一种潜在通信方法，既能减少模型替换后所需的接口重训练，又能降低共享通信组件带来的处理延迟。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we present LatBridge for efficient and stable model replacement in multi-agent systems. Figure 1 contrasts interface mismatch after model replacement with interface reuse through the Bridge. Structurally, LatBridge implements the shared communication component as the Bridge and connects the sending source agent and the receiving target agent through an input interface, a fixed Bridge model, and an output interface. When a model is replaced, the system reuses the unchanged interface and looks for a stored interface matching the new model. The two interfaces are connected through the fixed Bridge model. Only missing interfaces are trained, with all models frozen. The input and output interfaces learn representation mappings between adjacent models in separate training stages. Trained interfaces are stored by their adjacent models for use in the current and future matching configurations. Once the required interfaces are available, the system communicates through the input interface, complete frozen Bridge model, and output interface, preserving source-dependent communication. This procedure is called the basic mode. To reduce the latency caused by token-by-token Bridge generation, LatBridge prepares a vocabulary mapping and a corresponding output interface in advance, then uses the Bridge tokenizer and embedding lookup to construct target-side continuous input directly during communication. This procedure is called the accelerated mode. In the accelerated mode, the system bypasses autoregressive generation with the complete Bridge model, reducing communication processing time.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出 LatBridge，用于在多智能体系统中实现高效且稳定的模型替换。 图 1 对比了模型替换后的接口失配与通过 Bridge 实现的接口复用。 在结构上，LatBridge 将共享通信组件实现为 Bridge，并通过输入接口、固定的 Bridge 模型和输出接口连接发送方源智能体与接收方目标智能体。 当模型被替换时，系统复用保持不变的接口，并查找与新模型匹配的已存储接口。 这两个接口通过固定的 Bridge 模型连接。 只训练缺失的接口，所有模型均被冻结。 输入接口和输出接口在各自独立的训练阶段中学习相邻模型之间的表示映射。 训练好的接口按其相邻模型存储，供当前及未来的匹配配置使用。 一旦所需接口可用，系统便通过输入接口、完整的冻结 Bridge 模型和输出接口进行通信，从而保留依赖源的通信。 这一过程称为基础模式。 为减少 Bridge 逐 token 生成造成的延迟，LatBridge 预先准备好词表映射及对应的输出接口，然后在通信期间直接利用 Bridge 分词器和词嵌入查找来构建目标侧连续输入。 这一过程称为加速模式。 在加速模式中，系统绕过使用完整 Bridge 模型的自回归生成，从而缩短通信处理时间。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate LatBridge , we conduct model-replacement, communication-efficiency, ablation, and representation analyses at two model scales and across different endpoint-model configurations. As existing methods do not provide a suitable direct baseline for agent model replacement, we use controlled experiments, with Interlat as an accuracy reference. With matched interfaces, mean basic-mode accuracy across eight small-model configurations is 14.8% on MATH and 27.3% on ALFWorld next-action prediction. The scaling experiments show effective communication across the tested configurations. Ablation and representation analyses examine how interfaces, training, and communication content support task accuracy after replacement. The accelerated mode reduces Bridge processing latency while maintaining or improving average task accuracy. Complete experimental settings, results, and analyses are provided in Section 5 .

paragraphs.en: We identify interface failure after model replacement as an unresolved problem in latent-communication methods , and use a pilot study to show that the original interface cannot be directly reused after model replacement.

paragraphs.en: We present LatBridge , which implements a shared communication protocol through a communication component shared by all agents to support interface reuse after model replacement and avoids token-by-token Bridge generation in the accelerated mode.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate LatBridge in terms of task accuracy, communication efficiency, component roles, and representation space. The results show that matched interfaces support task accuracy after agent model replacement, while the accelerated mode improves communication efficiency.

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent systems coordinate role-specialized agents and have developed from dialogue-based collaboration to structured workflows ( Li et al., 2023 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) . Because text-based communication adds token generation and re-encoding overhead and may discard internal information, latent-communication methods pass embeddings ( Pham et al., 2024 ) , activations ( Ramesh and Li, 2025 ) , hidden states ( Du et al., 2026 ) , or key-value caches ( Shi et al., 2026 ) , with recent work further studying joint latent collaboration ( Zou et al., 2025 ) , cache transfer ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , learned messages ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) , and cross-model conversion ( Liu et al., 2026a ) . Meanwhile, model assignment ( Yue et al., 2025 ) , communication topology ( Li et al., 2024 ) , model diversity ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , and interaction design ( Liang et al., 2024 ) affect both performance and cost, creating a practical need to replace agent models while preserving existing task divisions and communication relations.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体系统协调角色专门化的智能体，并已从基于对话的协作发展到结构化工作流（Li et al., 2023；Hong et al., 2024；Wu et al., 2024）。 由于基于文本的通信会增加标记生成与重新编码的开销，并可能丢失内部信息，潜在通信方法转而传递嵌入（Pham et al., 2024）、激活值（Ramesh and Li, 2025）、隐藏状态（Du et al., 2026）或键值缓存（Shi et al., 2026），近期工作进一步研究了联合潜在协作（Zou et al., 2025）、缓存迁移（Fu et al., 2025）、可学习消息（Zheng et al., 2025）以及跨模型转换（Liu et al., 2026a）。 与此同时，模型分配（Yue et al., 2025）、通信拓扑（Li et al., 2024）、模型多样性（Chen et al., 2024）和交互设计（Liang et al., 2024）都会影响性能与成本，这使得在实际中需要在不改变既有任务分工与通信关系的前提下替换智能体模型。

paragraphs.en: However, existing latent-communication methods mainly build communication interfaces for fixed sending and receiving models, leaving interface reuse after model replacement unresolved. Drawing on model stitching ( Bansal et al., 2021 ) and low-rank adaptation ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , LatBridge establishes a shared communication protocol. This allows LatBridge to extend latent communication to changing agent-model configurations, with unaffected and matching interfaces reused after model replacement.

paragraphs.en: This leaves an unexamined problem: After the model assigned to an agent in a multi-agent system is replaced, can a latent-communication interface trained for the original model combination be reused directly and continue to pass task-relevant information to the target agent?
paragraphs.zh: 这就留下了一个未曾审视的问题：在多智能体系统中，分配给某个智能体的模型被替换后，为原始模型组合训练的潜空间通信接口能否被直接复用，并继续向目标智能体传递与任务相关的信息？

paragraphs.en: To answer this question, we model a directed communication relation in a multi-agent system as one-way communication between two models. A multi-agent system can be represented as a graph whose nodes are agents and whose directed edges are communication relations. Applying this model to each directed communication relation extends the analysis to multi-agent systems with different sizes and communication topologies. The sending model corresponds to the source agent, and the receiving model corresponds to the target agent, while both agents retain their task roles in the system. The next subsection examines this problem through a pilot study of model replacement.

paragraphs.en: Motivation. Existing latent-communication methods rely on interfaces trained for fixed model pairs, motivating separate representation mappings so that replacing one endpoint leaves the mapping on the other side unchanged. A natural solution is to establish a shared communication protocol implemented through a shared communication component used by all agents in a multi-agent system. For each directed communication relation, separate source-side and target-side interfaces divide the model-pair-dependent conversion across the two sides of this component. When an agent’s model is replaced, only its connection to this component changes, so the interface on the unchanged side can be reused and a new interface is trained only when no matching interface exists. This shared protocol forms the basis of LatBridge in Section 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 研究动机。 现有的潜空间通信方法依赖于针对固定模型对训练的接口，因此需要各自独立的表示映射，使得更换其中一个端点时另一侧的映射保持不变。 一个自然的解决方案是建立一个共享的通信协议，通过多智能体系统中所有智能体共用的共享通信组件来实现。 对于每条有向通信关系，源侧和目标侧的独立接口将依赖于模型对的转换拆分到该组件的两侧。 当某个智能体的模型被替换时，只有它与该组件的连接发生变化，因此未变更一侧的接口可以复用，只有在不存在匹配接口时才需要训练新接口。 这一共享协议构成了第 4 节中 LatBridge 的基础。

paragraphs.en: Interface retrieval and composition finds matching interfaces for the new configuration ( s , b , t ) (s,b,t) . Here, s s , b b , and t t denote the source-agent, Bridge, and target-agent models, with model functions f s f_{s} , f b f_{b} , and f t f_{t} . The Bridge contains an input interface ϕ s , b \phi_{s,b} , a frozen Bridge model, and an output interface ψ b , t \psi_{b,t} . The input and output interfaces connect the source and target models to the Bridge model, separating the representation conversion into two adjacent mappings. paragraphs.en: Efficient communication reduces Bridge processing time after model replacement. paragraphs.en: Models and configurations. Our main experiments use Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, and our scaling experiments use Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) . paragraphs.en: Evaluation. We use controlled experiments because existing methods do not provide a suitable direct baseline for agent model replacement. The Interlat pilot study provides an accuracy reference, while no-communication and ablation conditions assess the contribution of communication and individual components. The no-communication condition removes the Bridge output and retains only the fixed task instruction of the target agent. paragraphs.en: Module ablations. We ablate the interface components and training procedure in the small-model basic-mode setting while keeping the remaining experimental conditions fixed. As reported in Table 7 , removing either interface or using coupled output training reduces accuracy on both tasks, while joint optimization has task-dependent effects and updating the Bridge model provides no consistent improvement. These results show that separate interfaces and decoupled two-stage training support effective communication and provide a basis for adapting the adjacent interface while reusing the unchanged interface after model replacement. The complete variants, settings, and learned-parameter counts are provided in Appendix C.1 .

paragraphs.en: Representation analysis. Nearest-neighbor retrieval and linear probing both perform above their respective baselines, showing that the representations produced by both processing modes retain sample information. Although representations of the same sample have low raw similarity across the two modes, linear alignment recovers part of their correspondence. These results indicate that performance differences arise mainly from differences between representation spaces and from how well the target agent reads the transformed representations, rather than from a complete loss of task information. This also shows why model replacement requires matching the new model’s representation space so that the target agent can use the sample information carried by communication. Complete retrieval, probing, alignment, and receiver-space results are provided in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 表示分析。 最近邻检索和线性探测均优于各自的基线，表明两种处理模式产生的表示都保留了样本信息。 尽管同一样本在两种模式下的表示原始相似度较低，但线性对齐可以恢复部分对应关系。 这些结果表明，性能差异主要来自表示空间之间的差异以及目标智能体读取变换后表示的效果，而非任务信息的完全丢失。 这也说明了为什么模型替换需要匹配新模型的表示空间，以便目标智能体能够利用通信所携带的样本信息。 完整的检索、探测、对齐以及接收方空间结果见附录C。

paragraphs.en: This work studies interface reuse in existing latent-communication methods after agent model replacement. We presented LatBridge , which establishes a shared communication protocol through the Bridge and trains the interfaces on its two sides in two stages. After model replacement, it reuses unchanged and matching interfaces and trains only missing ones. In the accelerated mode, LatBridge avoids autoregressive Bridge generation to reduce communication processing time. Experiments at two model scales show that LatBridge maintains effective communication after agent model replacement and improves communication efficiency. Ablation and representation analyses confirm the roles of the interfaces, training procedure, and communicated representations in task performance.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究探讨在替换智能体模型后，现有潜在通信方法中接口的复用问题。 我们提出了 LatBridge，它通过 Bridge 建立共享的通信协议，并分两个阶段训练其两侧的接口。 在模型替换后，它复用未变化且匹配的接口，只训练缺失的接口。 在加速模式下，LatBridge 避免自回归的 Bridge 生成，以减少通信处理时间。 在两个模型规模上的实验表明，LatBridge 在智能体模型替换后仍能保持有效通信，并提升了通信效率。 消融实验和表征分析证实了接口、训练流程以及所通信的表征在任务性能中的作用。

paragraphs.en: Dependence on a fixed Bridge model. Interface composition and reuse in Section 4.2.2 assume that the Bridge model remains fixed, allowing the interface on the unchanged side to be reused after agent model replacement. If the Bridge model changes, the representation mappings on both sides may need adaptation, and the original interfaces may no longer be directly reusable. This work therefore addresses agent model replacement with a fixed shared communication component, rather than interface transfer after a Bridge-model update.
paragraphs.zh: 依赖于固定的桥接模型。 第 4.2.2 节中的接口组合与复用假设桥接模型保持固定，从而在智能体模型替换后，未变更一侧的接口可以被复用。 如果桥接模型发生变化，两侧的表示映射可能需要适配，原有接口可能不再能直接复用。 因此，本工作研究的是在共享通信组件固定的情况下进行智能体模型替换，而非桥接模型更新后的接口迁移。

sents.en: Dependence on a fixed Bridge model.
sents.zh: 依赖于固定的桥接模型。

sents.en: Interface composition and reuse in Section 4.2.2 assume that the Bridge model remains fixed, allowing the interface on the unchanged side to be reused after agent model replacement.
sents.zh: 第 4.2.2 节中的接口组合与复用假设桥接模型保持固定，从而在智能体模型替换后，未变更一侧的接口可以被复用。

sents.en: If the Bridge model changes, the representation mappings on both sides may need adaptation, and the original interfaces may no longer be directly reusable.
sents.zh: 如果桥接模型发生变化，两侧的表示映射可能需要适配，原有接口可能不再能直接复用。

sents.en: This work therefore addresses agent model replacement with a fixed shared communication component, rather than interface transfer after a Bridge-model update.
sents.zh: 因此，本工作研究的是在共享通信组件固定的情况下进行智能体模型替换，而非桥接模型更新后的接口迁移。

paragraphs.en: Model coverage. As described in Section 5.1 , our experiments cover two model families and two model scales to evaluate interface reuse, task accuracy, and communication efficiency across model configurations. These configurations include differences in hidden dimension and representation space, but do not cover a wider range of architectures, training approaches, or model-size differences. Other models may require different representation mappings, so the applicability of the current interface structure to broader model combinations remains to be evaluated.
paragraphs.zh: 模型覆盖度。 如第 5.1 节所述，我们的实验涵盖两个模型系列和两种模型规模，以评估不同模型配置下的接口复用、任务准确率和通信效率。 这些配置在隐藏维度和表示空间上存在差异，但并未涵盖更广泛的架构、训练方法或模型规模差异。 其他模型可能需要不同的表示映射，因此当前接口结构对更广泛模型组合的适用性仍有待评估。

sents.en: Model coverage.
sents.zh: 模型覆盖度。

sents.en: As described in Section 5.1 , our experiments cover two model families and two model scales to evaluate interface reuse, task accuracy, and communication efficiency across model configurations.
sents.zh: 如第 5.1 节所述，我们的实验涵盖两个模型系列和两种模型规模，以评估不同模型配置下的接口复用、任务准确率和通信效率。

sents.en: These configurations include differences in hidden dimension and representation space, but do not cover a wider range of architectures, training approaches, or model-size differences.
sents.zh: 这些配置在隐藏维度和表示空间上存在差异，但并未涵盖更广泛的架构、训练方法或模型规模差异。

sents.en: Other models may require different representation mappings, so the applicability of the current interface structure to broader model combinations remains to be evaluated.
sents.zh: 其他模型可能需要不同的表示映射，因此当前接口结构对更广泛模型组合的适用性仍有待评估。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent communication scale. Section 3.1 explains how individual communication relations form systems with different sizes and topologies, providing a basis for interface reuse across relations. Our experiments primarily test replacement within a single relation. Successive agent model replacements and multi-hop communication may introduce interactions and error accumulation, whose effects on overall task performance require system-level evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体通信规模。 第 3.1 节解释了个体通信关系如何构成具有不同规模和拓扑的系统，为跨关系的接口复用提供了基础。 我们的实验主要测试单一关系内的替换。 连续的智能体模型替换与多跳通信可能引入交互和误差累积，其对整体任务性能的影响需要进行系统级评估。

sents.en: Multi-agent communication scale.
sents.zh: 多智能体通信规模。

sents.en: Section 3.1 explains how individual communication relations form systems with different sizes and topologies, providing a basis for interface reuse across relations.
sents.zh: 第 3.1 节解释了个体通信关系如何构成具有不同规模和拓扑的系统，为跨关系的接口复用提供了基础。

sents.en: Our experiments primarily test replacement within a single relation.
sents.zh: 我们的实验主要测试单一关系内的替换。

sents.en: Successive agent model replacements and multi-hop communication may introduce interactions and error accumulation, whose effects on overall task performance require system-level evaluation.
sents.zh: 连续的智能体模型替换与多跳通信可能引入交互和误差累积，其对整体任务性能的影响需要进行系统级评估。

paragraphs.en: Tasks and evaluation. We evaluate task accuracy after model replacement through mathematical reasoning and offline action prediction, with data and scoring details in Appendix G . These evaluations test whether communicated representations support final-answer or next-action generation, but do not cover open-ended tasks or complete interactions with continuing environment feedback. In particular, offline next-action accuracy on ALFWorld does not directly measure full-task success. Multi-step decision-making and error recovery after model replacement remain to be evaluated through interactive tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 任务与评估。 我们通过数学推理和离线动作预测来评估模型替换后的任务准确率，数据与评分细节见附录 G。 这些评估测试的是所传递的表征能否支持最终答案或下一步动作的生成，但并未涵盖开放式任务或具有持续环境反馈的完整交互。 特别是，ALFWorld 上离线的下一步动作准确率并不能直接衡量完整任务的成功与否。 模型替换后的多步决策与错误恢复仍有待通过交互式任务进行评估。

sents.en: Tasks and evaluation.
sents.zh: 任务与评估。

sents.en: We evaluate task accuracy after model replacement through mathematical reasoning and offline action prediction, with data and scoring details in Appendix G .
sents.zh: 我们通过数学推理和离线动作预测来评估模型替换后的任务准确率，数据与评分细节见附录 G。

sents.en: These evaluations test whether communicated representations support final-answer or next-action generation, but do not cover open-ended tasks or complete interactions with continuing environment feedback.

sents.zh: 模型替换后的多步决策与错误恢复仍有待通过交互式任务进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Models and data. Our evaluation uses publicly available pretrained models and the MATH and ALFWorld benchmarks. MATH contains competition problems, and ALFWorld is a simulated household environment. This study involves no human participants, new human annotation, or new data collection. Model weights and datasets remain subject to their original licenses and terms of use.
paragraphs.zh: 模型与数据。 我们的评估使用公开可用的预训练模型以及 MATH 和 ALFWorld 基准测试。 MATH 包含竞赛题目，ALFWorld 是一个模拟的家庭环境。 本研究不涉及人类受试者、新的人类标注或新的数据收集。 模型权重和数据集仍受其原始许可证和使用条款的约束。

sents.en: Models and data.
sents.zh: 模型与数据。

sents.en: Our evaluation uses publicly available pretrained models and the MATH and ALFWorld benchmarks.
sents.zh: 我们的评估使用公开可用的预训练模型以及 MATH 和 ALFWorld 基准测试。

sents.zh: MATH 包含竞赛题目，ALFWorld 是一个模拟的家庭环境。

sents.zh: 模型权重和数据集仍受其原始许可证和使用条款的约束。

paragraphs.en: Safety and privacy. Latent inter-agent messages may be difficult to inspect with text-only moderation tools. Latent communication should not be treated as privacy protection because states may encode task or user information. After model replacement, deployed systems should reassess safety and retain human oversight for high-impact actions. Our offline next-action evaluation on ALFWorld does not establish safety for physical agents.
paragraphs.zh: 安全与隐私。 智能体之间的潜空间消息可能难以用纯文本审核工具进行检查。 潜空间通信不应被视为隐私保护手段，因为其状态可能编码任务或用户信息。 模型替换后，已部署的系统应重新评估安全性，并对高影响行为保留人类监督。 我们在 ALFWorld 上的离线下一步动作评估并不能证明物理智能体的安全性。

sents.en: Safety and privacy.
sents.zh: 安全与隐私。

sents.en: Latent inter-agent messages may be difficult to inspect with text-only moderation tools.
sents.zh: 智能体之间的潜空间消息可能难以用纯文本审核工具进行检查。

sents.en: Latent communication should not be treated as privacy protection because states may encode task or user information.
sents.zh: 潜空间通信不应被视为隐私保护手段，因为其状态可能编码任务或用户信息。

sents.en: After model replacement, deployed systems should reassess safety and retain human oversight for high-impact actions.
sents.zh: 模型替换后，已部署的系统应重新评估安全性，并对高影响行为保留人类监督。

sents.zh: 我们在 ALFWorld 上的离线下一步动作评估并不能证明物理智能体的安全性。

paragraphs.en: Replacement comparisons hold the Bridge model and the other agent’s model fixed. When the source-agent model is replaced, the output interface is reused. The system selects an input interface matched to the new source-agent model and current Bridge model, or trains this interface if it is unavailable. When the target-agent model is replaced, the input interface is reused. The system selects an output interface matched to the current Bridge model and new target-agent model, or trains this interface if it is unavailable. Matching interfaces can also be retrieved from other communication relations in the system.
paragraphs.zh: 替换比较保持桥接模型和另一个智能体的模型不变。 替换源智能体模型时，输出接口会被复用。 系统会选择与新的源智能体模型和当前桥接模型相匹配的输入接口，若该接口不可用则训练此接口。 替换目标智能体模型时，输入接口会被复用。 系统会选择与当前桥接模型和新的目标智能体模型相匹配的输出接口，若该接口不可用则训练此接口。 匹配的接口也可以从系统中其他通信关系里检索获得。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 groups the eight configurations by Bridge model and reports the basic and accelerated modes at both model scales. The mean row gives an unweighted average across the eight configurations for each task and mode. Across tasks, small-model means range from 14.8% to 27.3% in the basic mode and from 18.0% to 36.6% in the accelerated mode. The corresponding large-model means range from 28.0% to 28.7% and from 44.8% to 50.5%. The accelerated mode improves the average accuracy in all four model-scale–task comparisons, while individual small-model configurations can favor the basic mode.
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 按 Bridge 模型对八种配置进行分组，并在两个模型规模上报告基本模式和加速模式的结果。 均值行给出每种任务和模式下八种配置的未加权平均值。 跨任务来看，小模型均值在基本模式下介于 14.8% 到 27.3% 之间，在加速模式下介于 18.0% 到 36.6% 之间。 对应的大模型均值介于 28.0% 到 28.7% 以及 44.8% 到 50.5% 之间。 加速模式在全部四组模型规模–任务比较中都提高了平均准确率，而个别小模型配置可能更倾向于基本模式。

paragraphs.en: The large-model MATH results for a Qwen Bridge model and Llama target model use target-token re-embedding of the sequence generated by the Bridge. This setting retains autoregressive Bridge generation but changes how its output is supplied to the target model. The corresponding ALFWorld results use the hidden-state output mapping. The message-replacement and budget experiments use the hidden-state mapping throughout, as specified in Section C.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 针对 Qwen Bridge 模型与 Llama 目标模型的大模型 MATH 结果，对 Bridge 生成的序列使用了目标词元重嵌入（target-token re-embedding）。 这一设置保留了 Bridge 的自回归生成方式，但改变了其输出提供给目标模型的方式。 相应的 ALFWorld 结果则使用隐藏状态输出映射。 如 C.2 节所述，消息替换实验与预算实验全程使用隐藏状态映射。

paragraphs.en: Teacher-forced target loss supplements generated-answer accuracy by measuring the target model’s cross-entropy on the reference output. The model receives the same fixed instruction and continuous representation as in the corresponding accuracy evaluation. The evaluation code first computes one mean answer-token loss for each example and then averages these example-level losses. The loss is computed only at answer-token positions.

sents.zh: 教师强制目标损失通过测量目标模型在参考输出上的交叉熵来补充生成答案的准确率。

paragraphs.en: The local timer measures input-interface processing, Bridge processing, and output adaptation, ending when the target-side continuous input is ready. Device synchronization is applied before and after the measured interval. Source-state collection, source generation, target prompt construction, target decoding, sequential model loading, and host-device transfer take place outside the measured interval . In the accelerated mode, prompt tokenization and preloading also take place outside this interval. All measurements use an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090, bfloat16 precision, batch size 1, and 20 warm-up runs. After warm-up, each configuration is evaluated over the fixed task test set.
paragraphs.zh: 本地计时器测量输入接口处理、桥接处理和输出适配，直到目标侧的连续输入准备就绪时结束。 设备同步在测量区间之前和之后执行。 源状态收集、源生成、目标提示构建、目标解码、顺序模型加载以及主机-设备传输均发生在测量区间之外。 在加速模式下，提示分词和预加载也发生在该区间之外。 所有测量均使用 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090、bfloat16 精度、批大小 1 以及 20 次预热运行。 预热完成后，每个配置都在固定的任务测试集上进行评估。

paragraphs.en: The ablations test which parts of interface construction support task accuracy in the small-model basic mode. paragraphs.en: The five variants change one component or training choice at a time. Without two-stage training, the interfaces are jointly optimized. Without decoupled output training, the output interface’s training states change from separately collected teacher-forced states to Bridge states produced by the current communication process. The input-interface and output-interface variants remove the respective trainable mapping. Without Bridge-model freezing, rank-32 low-rank parameters in the Bridge model’s query and value projections are also updated.
paragraphs.zh: 这五种变体每次只改变一个组件或训练选择。 不使用两阶段训练时，各接口进行联合优化。 不使用解耦输出训练时，输出接口的训练状态从单独收集的教师强制状态变为由当前通信过程产生的桥接状态。 输入接口变体和输出接口变体分别移除对应的可训练映射。 不冻结桥接模型时，桥接模型中查询和值投影的秩为 32 的低秩参数也会被更新。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 reports task accuracy and the total number of trainable parameters for each variant. Removing either interface or using coupled output training reduces accuracy on both tasks. Joint optimization has task-dependent effects, while updating the Bridge model adds more than two million trainable parameters without a consistent accuracy improvement. The separate interfaces and training stages therefore support communication while keeping the Bridge model frozen.
paragraphs.zh: 表 7 报告了每个变体的任务准确率以及可训练参数的总数。 移除任一接口或使用耦合输出训练都会降低两个任务的准确率。 联合优化具有任务相关的效果，而更新 Bridge 模型会增加超过两百万个可训练参数，却未带来一致的准确率提升。 因此，分离的接口和训练阶段在保持 Bridge 模型冻结的同时支持了通信。

paragraphs.en: Message replacement tests whether the target model uses information specific to the current sample. This experiment uses the large models, a communication budget of 128, and the fixed evaluation sets described in Section G.1 . Bridge hidden states are passed through the trained output interface in every configuration, including the Qwen-Bridge-to-Llama-target configurations. This keeps the intervention on the same hidden-state path.
paragraphs.zh: 消息替换测试检验目标模型是否使用特定于当前样本的信息。 本实验使用大型模型、128 的通信预算以及 G.1 节中描述的固定评估集。 在每种配置中，桥接隐状态都会通过训练好的输出接口，包括 Qwen-Bridge-to-Llama-target 配置。 这样可以确保干预作用在同一条隐状态通路上。

paragraphs.en: Before the output interface, we replace randomly selected rows of a sample’s Bridge output with rows from another sample. The replacement sample is selected from the same MATH subject or ALFWorld task type and matched by sequence length. Its states are adjusted using row-wise root-mean-square matching. Replacement proportions are 0 0 , 0.10 0.10 , 0.25 0.25 , 0.50 0.50 , 0.75 0.75 , 0.90 0.90 , and 1.00 1.00 . Models, interfaces, and greedy decoding remain fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 在输出接口之前，我们将某个样本的 Bridge 输出中随机选取的若干行替换为来自另一样本的行。 替换样本从相同的 MATH 学科或 ALFWorld 任务类型中选取，并按序列长度进行匹配。 其状态通过逐行的均方根匹配进行调整。 替换比例为 0 0 、0.10 0.10 、0.25 0.25 、0.50 0.50 、0.75 0.75 、0.90 0.90 和 1.00 1.00 。 模型、接口和贪婪解码保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows the results for perturbation seed 0. Target-family means average the four source–Bridge combinations. The plotted 95% confidence bands use 10,000 bootstrap resamples of task identifiers, keeping the configurations for each example together. For Qwen targets, macro-average accuracy decreases from 22.7% to 0.4% on MATH and from 30.4% to 7.5% on ALFWorld. For Llama targets, it decreases from 10.0% to 0.8% and from 21.8% to 6.5%, respectively. These changes show that the target output depends on the sample information carried by the message. A fully mismatched message and the no-communication condition can produce different results.
paragraphs.zh: 图 3 展示了扰动种子 0 的结果。 目标族均值对四个源–Bridge 组合取平均。 图中绘制的 95% 置信带使用了对任务标识符的 10,000 次自助重采样，并将每个示例的配置保持在一起。 对于 Qwen 目标，宏平均准确率在 MATH 上从 22.7% 降至 0.4%，在 ALFWorld 上从 30.4% 降至 7.5%。 对于 Llama 目标，它分别从 10.0% 降至 0.8%，从 21.8% 降至 6.5%。 这些变化表明，目标输出依赖于消息所携带的样本信息。 完全不匹配的消息与无通信条件可能产生不同的结果。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 reports the configuration-level curves and target-family means. The confidence bands use the same task-level bootstrap procedure as the message-replacement plot. Accuracy decreases for most configurations as fewer states are retained, with different Bridge and target model pairs showing different rates of degradation. This experiment relates available message length to task accuracy. Truncation is applied after Bridge generation, so all retention proportions share the preceding complete autoregressive generation process.

paragraphs.en: This section expands the discussion in the main Related Work section. We first review agent organization and model selection, then latent communication, and finally efficient processing and representation mappings related to LatBridge .
paragraphs.zh: 本节扩展了主文中「相关工作」部分的讨论。 我们首先回顾智能体组织与模型选择，然后是潜在空间通信，最后是与 LatBridge 相关的高效处理与表示映射。

paragraphs.en: Research on agent organization explains why a multi-agent system may need to change its models while retaining its task roles and communication relations. Role-playing, software-development organizations, reusable conversation frameworks, and evaluation suites study how agents acquire responsibilities and coordinate ( Li et al., 2023 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . MasRouter jointly chooses a collaboration mode, role assignment, and language model ( Yue et al., 2025 ) , while sparse and learned topologies change information propagation and computation ( Li et al., 2024 ; Shen et al., 2025a ) . ReConcile aggregates diverse answers through confidence-weighted discussion ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . Controlled debate studies further show that gains depend on diversity, prompting, topology, and protocol design ( Liang et al., 2024 ; Smit et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . These studies motivate flexible agent configurations, whereas our work examines how latent communication can continue after an agent’s model is replaced.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体组织的研究解释了为什么多智能体系统可能需要在保留其任务角色和通信关系的同时更换其模型。 角色扮演、软件开发组织、可复用对话框架以及评估套件研究了智能体如何获取职责并进行协调（Li et al., 2023；Hong et al., 2024；Wu et al., 2024；Zhu et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2026）。 MasRouter 联合选择协作模式、角色分配和语言模型（Yue et al., 2025），而稀疏和可学习的拓扑则会改变信息传播与计算（Li et al., 2024；Shen et al., 2025a）。 ReConcile 通过置信度加权的讨论聚合多样化的答案（Chen et al., 2024）。 受控辩论研究进一步表明，性能提升取决于多样性、提示、拓扑和协议设计（Liang et al., 2024；Smit et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2024；Zhu et al., 2026）。 这些研究启发了灵活的智能体配置，而我们的工作则考察在智能体的模型被替换后，潜在通信如何能够继续进行。

paragraphs.en: Latent-communication methods exchange model representations instead of relying entirely on text. CIPHER sends expectations over token embeddings ( Pham et al., 2024 ) . Other methods communicate activations, token-level state-change trajectories, hidden states, or selected key-value layers ( Ramesh and Li, 2025 ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . Recent work also studies joint latent collaboration, cache-to-cache transfer, mixtures of hidden thoughts, learned thought messages, query-conditioned cache exchange, cross-model key-value conversion, and vision-language feature transfer ( Zou et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Fein-Ashley et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Kriuk and Ng, 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026b ) . These approaches demonstrate communication within their evaluated configurations, but do not establish whether the same interfaces remain usable after agent model replacement. Surveys and audits also examine semantic fidelity, causal dependence, and message integrity alongside efficiency ( Liu, 2026 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ; Brito and Baquero, 2026 ) . Unlike work focused on communication within fixed model configurations, LatBridge supports agent model replacement by reusing unaffected and existing matching interfaces and training only missing ones.
paragraphs.zh: 潜空间通信方法交换模型表示，而不是完全依赖文本。 CIPHER 通过词元嵌入发送期望（Pham et al., 2024）。 其他方法则传递激活值、词元级状态变化轨迹、隐藏状态或选定的键值层（Ramesh and Li, 2025；Tang et al., 2025；Du et al., 2026；Shi et al., 2026）。 近期工作还研究了联合潜空间协作、缓存到缓存的传输、隐藏思维的混合、学习到的思维消息、查询条件化的缓存交换、跨模型键值转换以及视觉-语言特征迁移（Zou et al., 2025；Fu et al., 2025；Fein-Ashley et al., 2025；Zheng et al., 2025；Kriuk and Ng, 2025；Liu et al., 2026a；Liu et al., 2026b）。 这些方法在其所评估的配置内实现了通信，但并未确立相同的接口在智能体模型被替换后是否仍然可用。 综述与审计工作还考察了语义保真度、因果依赖和消息完整性以及效率（Liu, 2026；Cheng et al., 2026；Brito and Baquero, 2026）。 与专注于固定模型配置内通信的工作不同，LatBridge 通过复用未受影响的既有匹配接口并仅训练缺失的接口，从而支持智能体模型的替换。

paragraphs.en: Related efficiency methods change either the reasoning process or the information exchanged between models. Transcript internalization distills a multi-agent interaction into one model ( Yi et al., 2026 ) . Continuous and compressed reasoning studies computation within a single model ( Hao et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2025b ; Cheng and Van Durme, 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Goyal et al., 2024 ; Pfau et al., 2024 ; Chang et al., 2026 ) , while prompt and rationale compression shortens text inputs ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Ren et al., 2023 ; Xia et al., 2025 ) . In contrast, LatBridge retains distinct source and target agents and reduces the processing time of the shared communication component while supporting model replacement. It does not merge collaboration into a single model or merely compress text.
paragraphs.zh: 相关的效率方法要么改变推理过程，要么改变模型之间交换的信息。 记录内化将多智能体交互蒸馏到单个模型中（Yi et al., 2026）。 连续且压缩的推理研究单个模型内部的计算（Hao et al., 2025; Shen et al., 2025b; Cheng and Van Durme, 2024; Liu et al., 2024; Goyal et al., 2024; Pfau et al., 2024; Chang et al., 2026），而提示与推理压缩则缩短文本输入（Jiang et al., 2023; Ren et al., 2023; Xia et al., 2025）。 相比之下，LatBridge 保留各自独立的源智能体和目标智能体，并缩短共享通信组件的处理时间，同时支持模型替换。 它既不将协作合并到单个模型中，也不只是压缩文本。

sents.zh: 连续且压缩的推理研究单个模型内部的计算（Hao et al., 2025; Shen et al., 2025b; Cheng and Van Durme, 2024; Liu et al., 2024; Goyal et al., 2024; Pfau et al., 2024; Chang et al., 2026），而提示与推理压缩则缩短文本输入（Jiang et al., 2023; Ren et al., 2023; Xia et al., 2025）。

sents.en: In contrast, LatBridge retains distinct source and target agents and reduces the processing time of the shared communication component while supporting model replacement.
sents.zh: 相比之下，LatBridge 保留各自独立的源智能体和目标智能体，并缩短共享通信组件的处理时间，同时支持模型替换。

sents.en: It does not merge collaboration into a single model or merely compress text.
sents.zh: 它既不将协作合并到单个模型中，也不只是压缩文本。

paragraphs.en: Research on representation mappings provides methods for converting representations between models. Model stitching studies connections between model representations, while low-rank adaptation reduces the number of trainable parameters ( Bansal et al., 2021 ; Hu et al., 2022 ) . Vocabulary adaptation and embedding alignment address related differences between tokenizers ( Li et al., 2025 ; Truong et al., 2025 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) . Research on representational convergence and representation similarity also informs our analysis of sample correspondence across models ( Huh et al., 2024 ; Kornblith et al., 2019 ) . LatBridge draws on these representation-mapping methods to implement a shared communication protocol. Its focus is on independently matching and reusing interfaces after agent model replacement, rather than only learning mappings between fixed models.
paragraphs.zh: 表征映射方面的研究提供了在模型之间转换表征的方法。 模型拼接研究模型表征之间的连接，而低秩适配则减少可训练参数的数量（Bansal 等，2021；Hu 等，2022）。 词表适配与嵌入对齐处理分词器之间相关的差异（Li 等，2025；Truong 等，2025；Singh 等，2026）。 关于表征收敛与表征相似性的研究也为我们分析跨模型的样本对应关系提供了依据（Huh 等，2024；Kornblith 等，2019）。 LatBridge 借鉴这些表征映射方法来实现一种共享的通信协议。 其重点是在智能体模型替换后独立地匹配和复用接口，而不仅仅是在固定模型之间学习映射。

paragraphs.en: This section provides the settings and reporting details for the pilot study in Section 3.2 . The experiment tests whether an interface trained by an existing latent-communication method remains usable after an agent model is replaced.
paragraphs.zh: 本节提供了 3.2 节中试点研究的设置与报告细节。 该实验测试的是：在替换智能体模型后，由现有潜在通信方法训练的界面是否仍然可用。

sents.en: This section provides the settings and reporting details for the pilot study in Section 3.2 .
sents.zh: 本节提供了 3.2 节中试点研究的设置与报告细节。

sents.en: The experiment tests whether an interface trained by an existing latent-communication method remains usable after an agent model is replaced.
sents.zh: 该实验测试的是：在替换智能体模型后，由现有潜在通信方法训练的界面是否仍然可用。

paragraphs.en: We use Interlat ( Du et al., 2026 ) with Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct as the source- and target-agent models. For each target model, we compare three conditions. The original model combination uses the source model for which the interface was trained. The model-replacement condition changes the source model while keeping the target model and original interface fixed. The no-communication condition removes the communicated representation and retains only the target agent’s fixed instruction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Interlat（Du et al., 2026），并采用 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct 和 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 分别作为源智能体和目标智能体模型。 对于每个目标模型，我们比较三种条件。 原始模型组合使用训练接口时所用的源模型。 模型替换条件在保持目标模型和原始接口不变的情况下更换源模型。 无通信条件移除所通信的表示，仅保留目标智能体的固定指令。

sents.en: We use Interlat ( Du et al., 2026 ) with Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct as the source- and target-agent models.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Interlat（Du et al., 2026），并采用 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct 和 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 分别作为源智能体和目标智能体模型。

sents.zh: 对于每个目标模型，我们比较三种条件。

sents.en: The original model combination uses the source model for which the interface was trained.
sents.zh: 原始模型组合使用训练接口时所用的源模型。

sents.en: The model-replacement condition changes the source model while keeping the target model and original interface fixed.
sents.zh: 模型替换条件在保持目标模型和原始接口不变的情况下更换源模型。

sents.en: The no-communication condition removes the communicated representation and retains only the target agent’s fixed instruction.
sents.zh: 无通信条件移除所通信的表示，仅保留目标智能体的固定指令。

paragraphs.en: The source agent reads the task and its context and produces a continuous representation. The target agent receives only this representation and a fixed task instruction, without directly observing the task input. We evaluate 200 MATH examples using final-answer exact match and 134 held-out ALFWorld examples using normalized next-action exact match. These task scores measure whether the interface passes useful information.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation preserves the target-side input condition across the compared configurations. The source agent receives the task and context, and the Bridge receives the Bridge-side task prompt. The target agent receives only its fixed instruction and the continuous input constructed by the Bridge. In the no-communication condition, this continuous input is removed.
paragraphs.zh: 评估在对比的不同配置之间保持目标侧输入条件不变。 源智能体接收任务和上下文，Bridge 接收 Bridge 侧的任务提示。 目标智能体仅接收其固定指令以及由 Bridge 构建的连续输入。 在无通信条件下，该连续输入被移除。

paragraphs.en: MATH scoring extracts a boxed answer when present and applies LaTeX normalization before exact comparison. The reported small-model evaluation also uses fallback extraction for responses without a boxed answer, checking mathematical expressions, explicit answer phrases, and a final standalone number. ALFWorld scoring normalizes the predicted and reference actions before exact comparison. Its score measures offline next-action prediction rather than full interactive task success.
paragraphs.zh: MATH 评分在存在方框答案时提取方框内的答案，并在精确比较前进行 LaTeX 规范化。 所报告的小模型评估还对没有方框答案的回复使用回退提取，检查数学表达式、明确的答案短语以及最后一个独立的数字。 ALFWorld 评分在精确比较前对预测动作和参考动作进行规范化。 其分数衡量的是离线的下一步动作预测，而非完整的交互式任务成功。

sents.zh: MATH 评分在存在方框答案时提取方框内的答案，并在精确比较前进行 LaTeX 规范化。

paragraphs.en: The two stages train the adjacent mappings separately, allowing an existing interface to be reused when the other side changes. The input interface is trained for three epochs with a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} . The output interface is trained for ten epochs with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} . The standard configurations use AdamW and training seed 0. For these configurations, the small-model micro-batch size is 2 with four accumulation steps, while the large-model micro-batch size is 1 with eight accumulation steps. Both therefore have an effective batch size of 8.

paragraphs.en: The accelerated mode requires an output interface trained for the embedding-based input that it will receive during communication. The training procedure constructs target embeddings from the Bridge-side task prompt using the vocabulary mapping described in Section E.3 . These embeddings replace teacher-forced Bridge states in the target-model cross-entropy objective. The large-model experiments use the output-interface settings given above. The small-model accelerated-mode report uses rank-32 output interfaces trained for five epochs with AdamW, a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , and dropout 0.1. The resulting interfaces are stored by their Bridge model, target model, and processing mode.

paragraphs.en: In MATH_10 , the task asks for the smallest x x satisfying | 5 ​ x − 1 | = | 3 ​ x + 2 | \lvert 5x-1\rvert=\lvert 3x+2\rvert . The reference answer is − 1 / 8 -1/8 .
